name: arxiv_search
description: Search arXiv for REAL preprints and get their genuine arxiv.org/abs/ URL, exact title, authors and abstract. USE THIS instead of writing an arXiv id from memory — invented ids look valid but resolve to unrelated papers. Returns Atom XML; read the <id> and <title> of each <entry>.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: arXiv query syntax. Use ti:"exact title" for a known paper, or all:keyword1 AND all:keyword2 to search broadly. Quote multi-word phrases.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: How many results to return. Use 3-5.
